name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML)
intro: This track invites participants to apply data-driven intelligence to decision-making in agriculture. Solutions should be practical for smallholder and commercial farmers, should explain their outputs in plain language, and should acknowledge the uncertainty that is inherent in any prediction.
problemTitles: Problem Title 1: AI-Powered Farmer Assistant
Problem Title 2: AI-Based Crop Disease and Pest Prediction
Problem Title 3: AI-Powered Farmer-to-Market Connectivity
Problem Title 4: AI-Based Crop Yield Prediction
Problem Title 5: AI-Based Livestock Disease Prediction and Early Warning
Problem Title 6: AI-Powered Weather and Climate Risk Prediction

name: Internet of Things (IoT)
intro: This track focuses on low-cost sensing, communication, and control systems that bring real-time information and automation to farms and post-harvest operations. Solutions should be rugged, energy-conscious, and simple enough for farmers to install and maintain.
problemTitles: Problem Title 1: Smart Irrigation and Water Management
Problem Title 2: Smart Agricultural Leaf Drying System
Problem Title 3: Smart Agricultural Storage and Spoilage Prevention
Problem Title 4: Smart Coconut Farming and Plantation Monitoring
Problem Title 5: Development of a Low-Cost, Lightweight Milk Chilling Can for Small-Scale Dairy Farmers
Problem Title 6: Smart Farm Security and Crop Protection

name: Drones and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Technology
intro: This track explores the use of unmanned aerial vehicles for observing, mapping, and treating farmland. Participants should consider regulatory requirements, flight safety, and the practical limits of aerial observation, and should present aerial findings as indications that support, not replace, ground verification.
problemTitles: Problem Title 1: Drone-Based Crop Health Monitoring
Problem Title 2: Precision Spraying and Agricultural Chemical Optimization
Problem Title 3: Drone-Based Agricultural Mapping and Land Surveying
Problem Title 4: UAV-Based Pest Infestation Hotspot Detection

name: Renewable Energy and Green Technology
intro: This track addresses the energy needs of farms and agricultural enterprises through renewable and sustainable technologies. Participants should consider energy availability, cost, storage, and the environmental benefits of their proposals, and should state their assumptions about energy supply and demand.
problemTitles: Problem Title 1: Renewable Energy-Based Smart Agricultural Drying System
Problem Title 2: Solar-Powered Smart Irrigation and Water Pumping System
Problem Title 3: Renewable Energy-Based Agricultural Cold Storage
Problem Title 4: Solar-Powered Agricultural Waste-to- Energy System
Problem Title 5: Renewable Energy-Powered Agricultural Processing System

name: Robotics and Automation
intro: This track encourages the design of machines that reduce repetitive, physically demanding, or hazardous agricultural work. Solutions must cope with uneven terrain, unstructured environments, and limited budgets, and should aim for reliability and safety around people.
problemTitles: Problem Title 1: Autonomous Agricultural Weeding Robot
Problem Title 2: Automated Fruit and Vegetable Harvesting Robot
Problem Title 3: Smart Seed Sowing and Precision Planting Robot
Problem Title 4: Autonomous Agricultural Material Transport Robot
Problem Title 5: Automated Fertilizer and Manure Application Robot
Problem Title 6: Automated Agricultural Sorting and Grading Robot

name: Open Innovation – Agriculture & Rural Development
intro: This track provides an open platform to develop simple, low-cost engineering aids, smart tools, or software applications that address practical challenges faced by farmers and rural communities.
problemTitles: Problem Title 1: Low-Cost Sugarcane Sett Cutting and Planting Aid
Problem Title 2: Low-Cost Paddy Field Levelling and Water-Depth Measurement Tool
Problem Title 3: Integrated Agricultural Government Schemes and Crop Insurance Assistance Platform
Problem Title 4: Banana Cultivation Cost and Harvest Planning Management System
Problem Title 5: Paddy Procurement Transparency and Digital Transaction Record System
